sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Chemical - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So, Sherlock, you want a riddle? You’re our pro on these headcrackers, right? Here, look. One lame hobo came around here. Either nuts of just demented, hell if I knew. All in rags, dirty head to toe, and the stench! A walking chemical weapon. Launched one on some vector, and where he goes, everything dies off. Hehe. Oh, damn, laughter through tears. But I digress. Just wanted to dispose of him, a bit farther away so the stink wouldn’t reach us, but one of our boys recognized his former homie in that pile of turd. Imagine that! Horrid things are going on, turning people from normal beings to such rubbish, and all for nothing! But that's not the point. The dude that recognized this heap of rags, said that he was not just a regular prick, but a Deputy Head of Security for two special sensitive zones on the Polikhim! Just imagine what kind of source could he become if he could at least remember his name, not just chew snots and mumble while slapping lips like a madman. What a shame! I don't know what got to him, but here's what I think. All this time that bagger lived somewhere, sleeping on some pissed-through mattresses, right? Right! You should look for that place. Need a hazmat suit? Haha, kidding. But if it comes to it, the hazmat’s on me, and not only it."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain any information about the Deputy Chief's past life on Customs
  - (Optional) Locate the sleeping place of the former Deputy Chief of Security on Customs
- Hand over the information to Skier
- Locate and obtain any item that could help with the investigation
- Hand over the items to Skier

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- 450 Euros
  - 472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)
- 1× 7.62x54mm R SP BT gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase for 7.62x54mm R SP BT at Skier LL1
"How long I live and wonder still. How was he surviving all this time? He can’t put two words together! Whatever. Let's first disinfect all this and wash it with cologne, and then open it and have a look."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Dorm room 220 key | 1 | Handover item | No | This is the item that "can help with the investigation". |
| Secure Folder 0013 | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This is the item that gives "information about the Deputy Chief's past life".; This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to pick up a secure folder and hand over a Dorm room 220 key. The wanted folder can be found in a train car on the western side of Customs. There are multiple spawns throughout the train car. After obtaining the folder, you must successfully extract from the location.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: Under a brick pallet in the northwestern corner of the train car.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: Under a pallet in the southeastern corner of the train car.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: Between the wall and a pallet in the northeastern corner of the train car.
